label: For every perfection, causes of that perfection do not go on to infinity: the relation 'c is a…
paraphrase: For every perfection, causes of that perfection do not go on to infinity: the relation 'c is a cause, distinct from x, of x's having the perfection' is well-founded, so there is neither an infinite backward series of such causes nor a cycle of them. Unattributed strengthening: the sources read here deny an infinite line within one species of cause (and efficient causes in the secunda via), not a mixed-species line of causes of one perfection.
